notes: Budgeted delivery E2, deliveries at the A1 budgets, $0: hash-vector re-import, every E2 variant through assembleEvidenceForHits with the per-call auto_packing, and the guard 1 record. No live call (the live cell does those on the slice).

cells.command: bash eval/runner/budgeted-delivery/e2-parallel.sh 16 "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/lme-s" -- --benchmark lme-s --system gbrain-query --embed hash --embedding-model openai:text-embedding-3-large --embedding-dims 1536 --config search.reranker.enabled=false --gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master@{{gbrain_sha}}" --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-09-gbrain-budgeted-delivery-e2/manifests/arms/retrieval-only.json --policy-setting variants=e2 --policy-setting stage=deliver --policy-setting b_pseudo={{b_pseudo_lme_s}} --policy-setting b_native={{b_native_lme_s}} --policy-setting b16_pseudo={{b16_pseudo_lme_s}} --frozen-from .e2-transfer/lme-s/frozen.ndjson
